editorial_pillars: Research-led documentaries and explainers with six distinct subject lanes and channel-specific narrative grammars.
Use concrete events, places, real flows, tactical action or human-system comparisons to answer an evidence-grounded question; scenarios are optional.
visual_direction: Follow references/visual-dna.md and the selected channel's visual_grammar. Use the shared original hand-drawn Chibi 2D educational illustration prompt for all six channels: friendly expressive compact characters when useful, bold clean dark outlines, warm luminous colors, gentle painterly texture, restrained cel shading, clear staging and readable forms. Apply the same finish to people, objects, environments, maps and explanatory diagrams; choose palette, period details and composition from verified episode evidence rather than copying a sample scene. Generate stills with Codex imagegen after narration approval and audio review. Do not retrieve video or use video montage. An illustration explains but does not prove an event. Preserve geography, time and visible state; use full-image reuse caps, exact localized text, spelling and phone/crop QA. Keep provenance internal. FFmpeg/NVENC adds camera movement only, not missing physical action. Episode thumbnails follow the subject/promise in this same Chibi 2D look and remain 1280x720.

music_library.selection: Choose a track to fit the episode and set its path as bgm_path in beats.json

caption_policy.reference_scope: Readability for same-language narration, informed by Netflix SDH guides; not a Netflix delivery-compliance claim.

visual_dna.subject_selection: Choose a supported human action or experience that explains the passage; objects, maps and diagrams lead when clearer.
visual_dna.character_presence: Actively plan people making, using, learning, exchanging, working and adapting. Give them a clear explanatory task and natural restrained expression. No fixed people ratio, obligatory host or whole-cast requirement.
visual_dna.consistency: Bold clean dark outlines, warm luminous colors, gentle painterly texture, restrained cel shading, readable silhouettes and clear staging; preserve researched period/place details.
visual_dna.scene_options: Chibi human scenes, environments, artifacts, maps, timelines, cutaways and process/comparison diagrams.
visual_dna.prompt_policy: Codex imagegen keyframes after narration approval and audio review. Distinct frames for changed action, expression, setting or fact. Internal provenance only.
visual_dna.review: Inspect factual scope, meaningful human action, clothing/tools, continuity, exact localized text, phone readability and crop. Illustration is not historical evidence.
visual_dna.motion_limit: The still renderer adds camera movement only, not body or object animation; changed physical states require distinct keyframes.

visual_workflow.existing_episode_policy: Keep recorded media/style unless the user requests a revision; no automatic migration.
